executive.title: Executive Dashboard
executive.description: A compact operating view for leadership, focused on revenue quality, stock reliability, order flow, and overall factory pulse.
executive.orderStatusDescription: How order volume is currently split across the pipeline.
executive.productMixDescription: Current catalog status mix across the factory portfolio.
executive.revenueHealthDescription: Discount pressure and profitability hygiene for the selected period.
executive.stockIntegrityDescription: Live physical versus theoretical stock alignment.
executive.operationsPulseDescription: A quick view of workload, returns, and open operational friction.

sales.title: Sales Dashboard
sales.description: Commercial performance across revenue trend, conversion health, customer value, discounts, and product demand.

kpis.cancellationRateHint: cancelled orders as a share of total

sales.revenueTrendDescription: Revenue and order count over time for the current filter set.
sales.orderTypeDescription: Revenue distribution between on-shelf and on-demand orders.
sales.topProductsDescription: Products generating the strongest commercial output.
sales.discountTrendDescription: How discount intensity shifts across time buckets.
sales.topCustomersDescription: Highest-value customer accounts in the selected period.
sales.returnsDescription: Items generating the highest return pressure.

production.title: Production Dashboard
production.description: Planning attainment, throughput, loss concentration, cycle time, and the batches creating the most drag.
production.trendDescription: Units produced and completed batch count over time.
production.lossByStageDescription: Where process loss is accumulating across the manufacturing flow.
production.statusMixDescription: Distribution of batches by operational state.
production.stageDurationDescription: Average elapsed hours per tracked production stage.
production.topLossBatchesDescription: Completed and active batches with the highest cumulative loss exposure.

inventory.title: Inventory Dashboard
inventory.description: Stock depth, stock movement pressure, color and season performance, and the products with the largest stock mismatch.
inventory.stockByLocationDescription: Current stock concentration across all factory locations.
inventory.movementBreakdownDescription: Movement count and handled volume by source-to-destination stock flow.
inventory.colorPerformanceDescription: Sell-through and current stock by color family.
inventory.seasonPerformanceDescription: Seasonal demand and stock exposure side by side.
inventory.mostMovedDescription: Products with the highest handling intensity.
inventory.varianceTableDescription: Products where physical and theoretical balances diverge.

operations.title: Operations Dashboard
operations.description: Issue volume, resolution performance, manual stock adjustments, and the team members driving issue throughput.
operations.issueTypeDescription: What kind of operational problems are appearing most often.
operations.statusMixDescription: How issue inventory is distributed across lifecycle stages.
operations.manualAdjustmentsDescription: Frequency and volume of manual stock corrections over time.
operations.resolutionTimeDescription: Average hours to resolve each class of operational issue.
operations.topReportersDescription: Users surfacing the largest number of issues.
operations.topResolversDescription: Users closing the highest number of issues.
